summary: Master 0.0001 mm 7-axis spatial audit and remediation report covering all 22 non-welcome modes (34 physical assemblies, 38 view states, 3,038 parts) across all 4 quality tiers (LITE/STD/HIGH/ULTRA), complete with 100% resolved source file:line citations, numeric ΔX/ΔY/ΔZ and hollow-cavity remediation patch specs, pp1.1 6-view ortho & mid-plane section cut visual evidence, and dependency-ordered remediation roadmap (Wave 0 -> Wave 4).
